name: Recipe Central
headline: Find your next favourite.
previewCopy: Thoughtful recipes and a little inspiration for whatever is on the menu.
description: Recipe Central welcomes home cooks with a food-photo carousel and quick recipe search, then invites them to explore dishes from around the world.
challenge: Make a growing recipe collection feel welcoming from the first visit, while giving people a quick way to find inspiration and start browsing.
response: Lead with vibrant food photography, a clear search entry point and a curated nine-recipe preview that connects straight to the full collection.
caseStudyContent:
## Overview
Recipe Central is a recipe discovery experience designed to make a growing collection feel approachable.

## Design focus
- A welcoming home page with a food-photo carousel
- A quick way to search and browse recipes
- A curated home-page preview that leads into the full collection

## Outcome
A responsive recipe experience with a clear path from inspiration to the recipe collection.

name: AssureX
headline: Warranty claims, made clearer.
previewCopy: Upload your receipt, check coverage, and understand our recommendation before you proceed.
description: AssureX is a competition prototype for warranty-claim intake, receipt OCR, Python-based structured-data scoring, Google Teachable Machine (GTM) claim-card scoring and human review. Its policies and model-training records are synthetic examples, not manufacturer warranties or evidence of real-world accuracy.
challenge: Make a complex claim assessment easier to follow while giving people clear explanations and a human-review path for uncertain cases.
response: Combine receipt OCR, structured-data scoring in Python and GTM claim-card scoring with human review. The demo policies and training records are synthetic; its outcomes do not establish manufacturer coverage or real-world model accuracy.
caseStudyContent:
## Overview
AssureX is a competition prototype that explores a more legible warranty-claim intake and review flow.

## Assessment flow
1. Capture claim details and extract receipt fields with OCR.
2. Compare structured data using Python scoring.
3. Include a Google Teachable Machine claim-card signal.
4. Route uncertain cases to human review.

## Important scope
Policies and training records are synthetic examples. The prototype does not establish manufacturer warranties, real-world accuracy, or production readiness.

name: Editorial Brand Study
headline: Made for the curious.
previewCopy: Thoughtful identities for places with a point of view.
description: A self-directed visual concept for an imaginary independent studio, exploring a grounded identity, confident typography and generous editorial space. This is not commissioned client work.
challenge: Explore a distinctive studio identity without implying a real client or business relationship.
response: Pair a confident wordmark with natural colors, spacious layouts and editorial project stories.
caseStudyContent:
## Concept brief
A self-initiated brand and web direction for an imaginary independent studio.

## Visual direction
Explore a confident wordmark, natural colors, and generous editorial layouts.

> Speculative exercise — not commissioned client work.
